def radiative_fluxes(self, atmosphere):

    if not hasattr(self, 'initialized'):
        import climt
        self.rad_lw = climt.RRTMGLongwave()
        self.rad_sw = climt.RRTMGShortwave()
        self.state0_lw = climt.get_default_state([self.rad_lw])
        self.state0_sw = climt.get_default_state([self.rad_sw])
        self.initialized = True

    self.update_radiative_state(atmosphere, self.state0_lw, sw=False)
    self.update_radiative_state(atmosphere, self.state0_sw, sw=True)

    lw_fluxes = self.rad_lw(self.state0_lw)
    sw_fluxes = self.rad_sw(self.state0_sw)

    return lw_fluxes, sw_fluxes
